verdict.rationale: Grok Bot is itself an AI agent that analyzes user data in-product. Its docs show it reviewing dashboards, traces, and flamegraphs to identify the highest-confidence latency hotspot, answering metrics questions from a data warehouse, running a scheduled customer-risk skill against an account list, and working with CSV, JSON, and Jupyter files. missing for 10: dedicated documentation of the insight/suggestion output (format, depth, proactive recommendations), independent or hands-on corroboration of data-analysis quality.
